table.retrieve:
SELECT
	ReportGroup = T.ReportGroup,
	SalesPersonCode=SM.SalesManCode,
	SalesPerson=SM.Name,
	Code = T.Code,
	Name= 
		CASE T.Type 
		WHEN 'REC' THEN (SELECT Area.Name FROM Area WHERE Area.AreaCode = T.Code) 
		ELSE (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = T.Code) 
		END,
	Receipts = SUM(CASE T.Type WHEN 'REC' THEN T.Amount ELSE 0 END),
	Expenses = SUM(CASE T.Type WHEN 'EXP' THEN T.Amount ELSE 0 END)
FROM
	SalesMan SM,
	(SELECT 
		ReportGroup = 1,
		Type = 'REC',
		SalesManCode = GH.SManCode,
		Code = (SELECT C.AreaCode FROM Customer C WHERE C.CustCode=GD.AccCode),
		Amount = SUM(GD.Credit)
	FROM
		GlHeader GH, GLDetail GD, VocherCategory VC
	WHERE
		GH.SManCode IN (:ai_smancode) AND
		GH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND GH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
		GH.Posted = 'Y' AND
		GH.VochCatCode = VC.VochCatCode AND
		VC.SHORTNAME <> 'SALEDISC' AND
		GH.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND
		GD.AccCode IN (SELECT A.AccCode FROM Accounts A WHERE A.SubCode = 3)
	GROUP BY
		GH.SManCode,
		GD.AccCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		ReportGroup = 2,
		Type = 'EXP',
		SalesManCode = GH.SManCode,
		Code=GD.AccCode,
		Amount = SUM(GD.Debit)
	FROM
		GlHeader GH, GLDetail GD
	WHERE
		GH.SManCode IN (:ai_smancode) AND
		GH.Date >= :ad_startdate AND GH.Date <= :ad_enddate AND
		GH.Posted = 'Y' AND
		GH.GLVochCode = GD.GLVochCode AND
		GD.AccCode IN 
			(SELECT A.AccCode 
			FROM Accounts A, SubAccounts SA, CategoryAccounts CA, MainAccounts M
			WHERE M.MainAccCode = 5 AND 
				M.MainAccCode = CA.MainAccCode AND
				CA.CatAccCode = SA.CatAccCode AND
				SA.SubAccCode = A.SubCode)
	GROUP BY
		GH.SManCode,
		GD.AccCode) T
WHERE
	SM.SalesManCode IN (:ai_smancode) AND
	SM.SalesManCode = T.SalesManCode
GROUP BY
	T.ReportGroup,
	T.Type,
	SM.SalesManCode,
	SM.Name,
	T.Code
ORDER BY
	SM.Name,
	ReportGroup,
	Name
